sources.finding: The operator confirmed claude-sonnet-5 as both the saved mapping key and the requested model ID. Saved configuration and model availability have not been inspected.

Static strings include q and runtime service hosts. Instruction and stop reason strings occur in other protocol and UI contexts. They do not establish the inference destination, instruction mapping, or completion contract.
The historical client installs a bearer token resolver and supplies optional profile metadata. This is not a current Kiro CLI contract.

Historical endpoint selection uses profile ARN region with a default US endpoint. It does not justify routing from the selected credential region. Reading profile metadata would require another architecture decision.
Historical event names justify invented local framing fixtures only. A complete event or tool stop does not prove completion of a model turn.
The offline reader validates both CRC32 checksums and bounded lengths. This generic framing contract does not supply a model completion signal.
